ayahs.ar: اَلَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا وَصَدُّوۡا عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ اَضَلَّ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Allazeena kafaroo wa saddoo'an sabeelil laahi adalla a'maalahum
ayahs.en: Those who disbelieve and avert [people] from the way of Allah - He will waste their deeds.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَاٰمَنُوۡا بِمَا نُزِّلَ عَلٰي مُحَمَّدٍ وَّهُوَ الۡحَقُّ مِنۡ رَّبِّهِمۡۙ كَفَّرَ عَنۡهُمۡ سَيِّاٰتِهِمۡ وَاَصۡلَحَ بَالَهُمۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati wa aamanoo bimaa nuzzila 'alaa Muhammadinw-wa huwal haqqu mir Rabbihim kaffara 'anhum saiyiaatihim wa aslaha baalahum
ayahs.en: And those who believe and do righteous deeds and believe in what has been sent down upon Muhammad - and it is the truth from their Lord - He will remove from them their misdeeds and amend their condition.

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوا اتَّبَعُوا الۡبَاطِلَ وَاَنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوا اتَّبَعُوا الۡحَقَّ مِنۡ رَّبِّهِمۡؕ كَذٰلِكَ يَضۡرِبُ اللّٰهُ لِلنَّاسِ اَمۡثَالَهُمۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Zaalika bi annal lazeena kafarut taba'ul baatila wa annal lazeena aamanut taba'ul haqqa mir Rabbihim; kazaalika yadribul laahu linnaasi amsaalahum
ayahs.en: That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood, and those who believe follow the truth from their Lord. Thus does Allah present to the people their comparisons.

ayahs.ar: فَاِذَا لَقِيۡتُمُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا فَضَرۡبَ الرِّقَابِؕ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا٘ اَثۡخَنۡتُمُوۡهُمۡ فَشُدُّوا الۡوَثَاقَۙ فَاِمَّا مَنًّاۭ بَعۡدُ وَاِمَّا فِدَآءً حَتّٰي تَضَعَ الۡحَرۡبُ اَوۡزَارَهَا ࣢ۚࣞۛ ذٰلِكَؕۛ وَلَوۡ يَشَآءُ اللّٰهُ لَانۡتَصَرَ مِنۡهُمۡۙ وَلٰكِنۡ لِّيَبۡلُوَا۠ بَعۡضَكُمۡ بِبَعۡضٍؕ وَالَّذِيۡنَ قُتِلُوۡا فِيۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ فَلَنۡ يُّضِلَّ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa-izaa laqeetumul lazeena kafaroo fadarbar riqaab, hattaaa izaa askhan tumoohum fashuddul wasaaq, fa immaa mannnam ba'du wa immaa fidaaa'an hattaa tada'al harbu awzaarahaa; zaalika wa law yashaaa'ul laahu lantasara minhum wa laakil laiyabluwa ba'dakum biba'd; wallazeena qutiloo fee sabeelil laahi falany yudilla a'maalahum
ayahs.en: So when you meet those who disbelieve [in battle], strike [their] necks until, when you have inflicted slaughter upon them, then secure their bonds, and either [confer] favor afterwards or ransom [them] until the war lays down its burdens. That [is the command]. And if Allah had willed, He could have taken vengeance upon them [Himself], but [He ordered armed struggle] to test some of you by means of others. And those who are killed in the cause of Allah - never will He waste their deeds.

ayahs.ar: سَيَهۡدِيۡهِمۡ وَيُصۡلِحُ بَالَهُمۡۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Sa-yahdeehim wa yusihu baalahum
ayahs.en: He will guide them and amend their condition

ayahs.ar: وَيُدۡخِلُهُمُ الۡجَنَّةَ عَرَّفَهَا لَهُمۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa yudkhiluhumul jannata 'arrafahaa lahum
ayahs.en: And admit them to Paradise, which He has made known to them.

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡ٘ا اِنۡ تَنۡصُرُوا اللّٰهَ يَنۡصُرۡكُمۡ وَيُثَبِّتۡ اَقۡدَامَكُمۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Yaaa ayyuhal lazeena aamanooo in tansurul laaha yansurkum wa yusabbit aqdaamakum
ayahs.en: O you who have believed, if you support Allah, He will support you and plant firmly your feet.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا فَتَعۡسًا لَّهُمۡ وَاَضَلَّ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena kafaroo fata's al lahum wa adalla a'maalahum
ayahs.en: But those who disbelieve - for them is misery, and He will waste their deeds.

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمۡ كَرِهُوۡا مَا٘ اَنۡزَلَ اللّٰهُ فَاَحۡبَطَ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Zaalika bi annahum karihoo maaa anzalal laahu faahbata a'maalahum
ayahs.en: That is because they disliked what Allah revealed, so He rendered worthless their deeds.

ayahs.ar: اَفَلَمۡ يَسِيۡرُوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ فَيَنۡظُرُوۡا كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡؕ دَمَّرَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيۡهِمۡؗ وَلِلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ اَمۡثَالُهَا
ayahs.tl: Afalam yaseeroo fil ardi fayanzuroo kaifa kaana 'aaqibatul lazeena min qablihim; dammaral laahu 'alaihim wa lilkaafireena amsaaluhaa
ayahs.en: Have they not traveled through the land and seen how was the end of those before them? Allah destroyed [everything] over them, and for the disbelievers is something comparable.

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّ اللّٰهَ مَوۡلَي الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَاَنَّ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ لَا مَوۡلٰي لَهُمۡࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Zaalika bi annal laaha mawlal lazeena aamanoo wa annal kaafireena laa mawlaa lahum
ayahs.en: That is because Allah is the protector of those who have believed and because the disbelievers have no protector.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُدۡخِلُ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ جَنّٰتٍ تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُؕ وَالَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا يَتَمَتَّعُوۡنَ وَيَاۡكُلُوۡنَ كَمَا تَاۡكُلُ الۡاَنۡعَامُ وَالنَّارُ مَثۡوًي لَّهُمۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Innal-laaha yudkhilul lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati Jannaatin tajree min tahtihal anhaaru wallazeena kafaroo yatamatta'oona wa yaakuloona kamaa taakuluian'aamu wan Naaru maswallahum
ayahs.en: Indeed, Allah will admit those who have believed and done righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow, but those who disbelieve enjoy themselves and eat as grazing livestock eat, and the Fire will be a residence for them.

ayahs.ar: وَكَاَيِّنۡ مِّنۡ قَرۡيَةٍ هِيَ اَشَدُّ قُوَّةً مِّنۡ قَرۡيَتِكَ الَّتِيۡ٘ اَخۡرَجَتۡكَۚ اَهۡلَكۡنٰهُمۡ فَلَا نَاصِرَ لَهُمۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa ka ayyim min qaryatin hiya ashaddu quwwatam min qaryatikal lateee akhrajatka ahlaknaahum falaa naasira lahum
ayahs.en: And how many a city was stronger than your city [Makkah] which drove you out? We destroyed them; and there was no helper for them.

ayahs.ar: اَفَمَنۡ كَانَ عَلٰي بَيِّنَةٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّهٖ كَمَنۡ زُيِّنَ لَهٗ سُوۡٓءُ عَمَلِهٖ وَاتَّبَعُوۡ٘ا اَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Afaman kaana 'alaa baiyinatim mir Rabbihee kaman zuyyina lahoo sooo'u 'amalihee wattaba'ooo ahwaaa'ahum
ayahs.en: So is he who is on clear evidence from his Lord like him to whom the evil of his work has been made attractive and they follow their [own] desires?

ayahs.ar: مَثَلُ الۡجَنَّةِ الَّتِيۡ وُعِدَ الۡمُتَّقُوۡنَؕ فِيۡهَا٘ اَنۡهٰرٌ مِّنۡ مَّآءٍ غَيۡرِ اٰسِنٍۚ وَاَنۡهٰرٌ مِّنۡ لَّبَنٍ لَّمۡ يَتَغَيَّرۡ طَعۡمُهٗۚ وَاَنۡهٰرٌ مِّنۡ خَمۡرٍ لَّذَّةٍ لِّلشّٰرِبِيۡنَ ࣢ۚ وَاَنۡهٰرٌ مِّنۡ عَسَلٍ مُّصَفًّيؕ وَلَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا مِنۡ كُلِّ الثَّمَرٰتِ وَمَغۡفِرَةٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّهِمۡؕ كَمَنۡ هُوَ خَالِدٌ فِي النَّارِ وَسُقُوۡا مَآءً حَمِيۡمًا فَقَطَّعَ اَمۡعَآءَهُمۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Masalul jannatil latee wu'idal muttaqoona feehaaa anhaarum mim maaa'in ghayri aasininw wa anhaarum mil labanil lam yataghaiyar ta'muhoo wa anhaarum min khamril lazzatil lishshaaribeena wa anhaarum min 'asalim musaffanw wa lahum feeha min kullis samaraati wa maghfiratum mir Rabbihim kaman huwa khaalidun fin naari wa suqoo maaa'an hameeman faqatta'a am'aaa'ahum
ayahs.en: Is the description of Paradise, which the righteous are promised, wherein are rivers of water unaltered, rivers of milk the taste of which never changes, rivers of wine delicious to those who drink, and rivers of purified honey, in which they will have from all [kinds of] fruits and forgiveness from their Lord, like [that of] those who abide eternally in the Fire and are given to drink scalding water that will sever their intestines?

ayahs.ar: وَمِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ يَّسۡتَمِعُ اِلَيۡكَۚ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا خَرَجُوۡا مِنۡ عِنۡدِكَ قَالُوۡا لِلَّذِيۡنَ اُوۡتُوا الۡعِلۡمَ مَاذَا قَالَ اٰنِفًاࣞ اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيۡنَ طَبَعَ اللّٰهُ عَلٰي قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ وَاتَّبَعُوۡ٘ا اَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa minhum mai yastami' ilaika hattaaa izaa kharajoo min 'indika qaaloo lillazeena ootul 'ilma maazaa qaala aanifaa; ulaaa'ikal lazeena taba'al laahu 'alaa quloobihim wattaba'ooo ahwaaa'ahum
ayahs.en: And among them, [O Muhammad], are those who listen to you, until when they depart from you, they say to those who were given knowledge, "What has he said just now?" Those are the ones of whom Allah has sealed over their hearts and who have followed their [own] desires.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اهۡتَدَوۡا زَادَهُمۡ هُدًي وَّاٰتٰىهُمۡ تَقۡوٰىهُمۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallazeenah tadaw zaadahum hudanw wa aataahum taqwaahum
ayahs.en: And those who are guided - He increases them in guidance and gives them their righteousness.

ayahs.ar: فَهَلۡ يَنۡظُرُوۡنَ اِلَّا السَّاعَةَ اَنۡ تَاۡتِيَهُمۡ بَغۡتَةًۚ فَقَدۡ جَآءَ اَشۡرَاطُهَاۚ فَاَنّٰي لَهُمۡ اِذَا جَآءَتۡهُمۡ ذِكۡرٰىهُمۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Fahal yanzuroona illas Saa'ata an taatiyahum baghtatan faqad jaaa'a ashraatuhaa; fa-annnaa lahum izaa jaaa'at hum zikraahum
ayahs.en: Then do they await except that the Hour should come upon them unexpectedly? But already there have come [some of] its indications. Then what good to them, when it has come, will be their remembrance?

ayahs.ar: فَاعۡلَمۡ اَنَّهٗ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَاسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لِذَنۭۡ بِكَ وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ وَالۡمُؤۡمِنٰتِؕ وَاللّٰهُ يَعۡلَمُ مُتَقَلَّبَكُمۡ وَمَثۡوٰىكُمۡࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa'lam annahoo laaa ilaaha illal laahu wastaghfir lizambika wa lilmu'mineena walmu'minaat; wallaahu ya'lamu mutaqallabakum wa maswaakum
ayahs.en: So know, [O Muhammad], that there is no deity except Allah and ask forgiveness for your sin and for the believing men and believing women. And Allah knows of your movement and your resting place.

ayahs.ar: وَيَقُوۡلُ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَتۡ سُوۡرَةٌۚ فَاِذَا٘ اُنۡزِلَتۡ سُوۡرَةٌ مُّحۡكَمَةٌ وَّذُكِرَ فِيۡهَا الۡقِتَالُۙ رَاَيۡتَ الَّذِيۡنَ فِيۡ قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ مَّرَضٌ يَّنۡظُرُوۡنَ اِلَيۡكَ نَظَرَ الۡمَغۡشِيِّ عَلَيۡهِ مِنَ الۡمَوۡتِؕ فَاَوۡلٰي لَهُمۡۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa yaqoolul lazeena aamanoo law laa nuzzilat Sooratun fa izaaa unzilat Sooratum Muhkamatunw wa zukira feehal qitaalu ra aytal lazeena fee quloobihim maraduny yanzuroona ilaika nazaral maghshiyyi 'alaihi minal mawti fa'awlaa lahum
ayahs.en: Those who believe say, "Why has a surah not been sent down? But when a precise surah is revealed and fighting is mentioned therein, you see those in whose hearts is hypocrisy looking at you with a look of one overcome by death. And more appropriate for them [would have been]

ayahs.ar: طَاعَةٌ وَّقَوۡلٌ مَّعۡرُوۡفٌࣞ فَاِذَا عَزَمَ الۡاَمۡرُࣞ فَلَوۡ صَدَقُوا اللّٰهَ لَكَانَ خَيۡرًا لَّهُمۡۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Taa'atunw wa qawlum ma'roof; fa izaa 'azamal amru falaw sadaqul laaha lakaana khairal lahum
ayahs.en: Obedience and good words. And when the matter [of fighting] was determined, if they had been true to Allah, it would have been better for them.

ayahs.ar: فَهَلۡ عَسَيۡتُمۡ اِنۡ تَوَلَّيۡتُمۡ اَنۡ تُفۡسِدُوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوۡ٘ا اَرۡحَامَكُمۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Fahal 'asaitum in tawallaitum an tufsidoo fil ardi wa tuqatti'ooo arhaamakum
ayahs.en: So would you perhaps, if you turned away, cause corruption on earth and sever your [ties of] relationship?

ayahs.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيۡنَ لَعَنَهُمُ اللّٰهُ فَاَصَمَّهُمۡ وَاَعۡمٰ٘ي اَبۡصَارَهُمۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Ulaaa'ikal lazeena la'anahumul laahu fa asammahum wa a'maaa absaarahum
ayahs.en: Those [who do so] are the ones that Allah has cursed, so He deafened them and blinded their vision.

ayahs.ar: اَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُوۡنَ الۡقُرۡاٰنَ اَمۡ عَلٰي قُلُوۡبٍ اَقۡفَالُهَا
ayahs.tl: Afalaa yatadabbaroonal Qur-aana am 'alaa quloobin aqfaaluhaa
ayahs.en: Then do they not reflect upon the Qur'an, or are there locks upon [their] hearts?

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ ارۡتَدُّوۡا عَلٰ٘ي اَدۡبَارِهِمۡ مِّنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الۡهُدَيۙ الشَّيۡطٰنُ سَوَّلَ لَهُمۡؕ وَاَمۡلٰي لَهُمۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeenar taddoo 'alaaa adbaarihim mim ba'di maa tabaiyana lahumul hudash Shaitaanu sawwala lahum wa amlaa lahum
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who reverted back [to disbelief] after guidance had become clear to them - Satan enticed them and prolonged hope for them.

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمۡ قَالُوۡا لِلَّذِيۡنَ كَرِهُوۡا مَا نَزَّلَ اللّٰهُ سَنُطِيۡعُكُمۡ فِيۡ بَعۡضِ الۡاَمۡرِۚ وَاللّٰهُ يَعۡلَمُ اِسۡرَارَهُمۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Zaalika bi annahum qaaloo lillazeena karihoo maa nazzalal laahu sanutee'ukum fee ba'dil amri wallaahu ya'lamu israarahum
ayahs.en: That is because they said to those who disliked what Allah sent down, "We will obey you in part of the matter." And Allah knows what they conceal.

ayahs.ar: فَكَيۡفَ اِذَا تَوَفَّتۡهُمُ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ يَضۡرِبُوۡنَ وُجُوۡهَهُمۡ وَاَدۡبَارَهُمۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Fakaifa izaa tawaffat humul malaaa'ikatu yadriboona wujoohahum wa adbaa rahum
ayahs.en: Then how [will it be] when the angels take them in death, striking their faces and their backs?

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمُ اتَّبَعُوۡا مَا٘ اَسۡخَطَ اللّٰهَ وَكَرِهُوۡا رِضۡوَانَهٗ فَاَحۡبَطَ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Zaalika bi annahumut taba'oo maaa askhatal laaha wa karihoo ridwaanahoo fa ahbata a'maalahum
ayahs.en: That is because they followed what angered Allah and disliked [what earns] His pleasure, so He rendered worthless their deeds.

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ حَسِبَ الَّذِيۡنَ فِيۡ قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ مَّرَضٌ اَنۡ لَّنۡ يُّخۡرِجَ اللّٰهُ اَضۡغَانَهُمۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Am hasibal lazeena fee quloobihim maradun al lan yukhrijal laahu adghaanahum
ayahs.en: Or do those in whose hearts is disease think that Allah would never expose their [feelings of] hatred?

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَاَرَيۡنٰكَهُمۡ فَلَعَرَفۡتَهُمۡ بِسِيۡمٰهُمۡؕ وَلَتَعۡرِفَنَّهُمۡ فِيۡ لَحۡنِ الۡقَوۡلِؕ وَاللّٰهُ يَعۡلَمُ اَعۡمَالَكُمۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa law nashaaa'u la-arainaakahum fala 'araftahum bi seemaahum; wa lata'rifan nahum fee lahnil qawl; wallaahu ya'lamu a'maalakum
ayahs.en: And if We willed, We could show them to you, and you would know them by their mark; but you will surely know them by the tone of [their] speech. And Allah knows your deeds.

ayahs.ar: وَلَنَبۡلُوَنَّكُمۡ حَتّٰي نَعۡلَمَ الۡمُجٰهِدِيۡنَ مِنۡكُمۡ وَالصّٰبِرِيۡنَۙ وَنَبۡلُوَا۠ اَخۡبَارَكُمۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa lanabluwannakum hattaa na'lamal mujaahideena minkum wassaabireena wa nabluwa akhbaarakum
ayahs.en: And We will surely test you until We make evident those who strive among you [for the cause of Allah] and the patient, and We will test your affairs.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا وَصَدُّوۡا عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ وَشَآقُّوا الرَّسُوۡلَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الۡهُدٰيۙ لَنۡ يَّضُرُّوا اللّٰهَ شَيۡـًٔاؕ وَسَيُحۡبِطُ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Innnal lazeena kafaroo wa saddoo 'an sabeelil laahi wa shaaaqqur Rasoola mim ba'di maa tabaiyana lahumul hudaa lany yadurrul laaha shai'anw wa sa yuhbitu a'maalahum
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted [people] from the path of Allah and opposed the Messenger after guidance had become clear to them - never will they harm Allah at all, and He will render worthless their deeds.

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡ٘ا اَطِيۡعُوا اللّٰهَ وَاَطِيۡعُوا الرَّسُوۡلَ وَلَا تُبۡطِلُوۡ٘ا اَعۡمَالَكُمۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Yaaa ayyuhal lazeena aamanoo atee'ul laaha wa atee'ur Rasoola wa laa tubtilooo a'maalakum
ayahs.en: O you who have believed, obey Allah and obey the Messenger and do not invalidate your deeds.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا وَصَدُّوۡا عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ ثُمَّ مَاتُوۡا وَهُمۡ كُفَّارٌ فَلَنۡ يَّغۡفِرَ اللّٰهُ لَهُمۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena kafaroo wa saddoo 'an sabeelil laahi summa maatoo wa hum kuffaarun falany yaghfirallaahu lahum
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted [people] from the path of Allah and then died while they were disbelievers - never will Allah forgive them.

ayahs.ar: فَلَا تَهِنُوۡا وَتَدۡعُوۡ٘ا اِلَي السَّلۡمِࣗۖ وَاَنۡتُمُ الۡاَعۡلَوۡنَࣗۖ وَاللّٰهُ مَعَكُمۡ وَلَنۡ يَّتِرَكُمۡ اَعۡمَالَكُمۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Falaa tahinoo wa tad'ooo ilas salmi wa antumul a'lawna wallaahu ma'akum wa lany yatirakum a'maalakum
ayahs.en: So do not weaken and call for peace while you are superior; and Allah is with you and will never deprive you of [the reward of] your deeds.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّمَا الۡحَيٰوةُ الدُّنۡيَا لَعِبٌ وَّلَهۡوٌؕ وَاِنۡ تُؤۡمِنُوۡا وَتَتَّقُوۡا يُؤۡتِكُمۡ اُجُوۡرَكُمۡ وَلَا يَسۡـَٔلۡكُمۡ اَمۡوَالَكُمۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Innamal hayaatud dunyaa la'ibunw wa lahw; wa in to'minoo wa tattaqoo yu'tikum ujoorakum wa laa yas'alkum amwaalakum
ayahs.en: [This] worldly life is only amusement and diversion. And if you believe and fear Allah, He will give you your rewards and not ask you for your properties.

ayahs.ar: اِنۡ يَّسۡـَٔلۡكُمُوۡهَا فَيُحۡفِكُمۡ تَبۡخَلُوۡا وَيُخۡرِجۡ اَضۡغَانَكُمۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Iny yas'alkumoohaa fa yuhfikum tabkhaloo wa yukhrij adghaanakum
ayahs.en: If He should ask you for them and press you, you would withhold, and He would expose your unwillingness.

ayahs.ar: هٰ٘اَنۡتُمۡ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ تُدۡعَوۡنَ لِتُنۡفِقُوۡا فِيۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِۚ فَمِنۡكُمۡ مَّنۡ يَّبۡخَلُۚ وَمَنۡ يَّبۡخَلۡ فَاِنَّمَا يَبۡخَلُ عَنۡ نَّفۡسِهٖؕ وَاللّٰهُ الۡغَنِيُّ وَاَنۡتُمُ الۡفُقَرَآءُۚ وَاِنۡ تَتَوَلَّوۡا يَسۡتَبۡدِلۡ قَوۡمًا غَيۡرَكُمۡۙ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُوۡنُوۡ٘ا اَمۡثَالَكُمۡࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: haaa antum haaa'ulaaa'i tud'awna litunfiqoo fee sabeelillaahi faminkum many yabkhalu wa many yabkhal fa innamaa yabkhalu 'an nafsih; wallaahu Ghaniyyu wa antumul fuqaraaa'; wa in tatwal law yastabdil qawman ghairakum summa laa yakoonooo amsaalakum
ayahs.en: Here you are - those invited to spend in the cause of Allah - but among you are those who withhold [out of greed]. And whoever withholds only withholds [benefit] from himself; and Allah is the Free of need, while you are the needy. And if you turn away, He will replace you with another people; then they will not be the likes of you.
